calls.price_at_call: ~$5 or less (stated; was $10 when put on do-not-buy list)
calls.thesis: AVOID first tracked (guest Joel Litman, Altimetry Research) — Quantum Computing Inc. is top of his personal avoid list: circular financing (a big chunk of revenue came from a company that never paid, which Quantum then bought), a history of restatements, and auditors repeatedly chastised by the PCAOB (one banned); he believes in quantum tech but not this company's books.
calls.base_case: Stock keeps falling rather than rebounding like the other two picks; down over the year and will continue to go down.
calls.bull_case: Quantum technology itself is real and could do a lot — but that does not make this company investable.
calls.bear_case: Further restatements or governance failures; revenue-quality issues persist.
calls.video_title: 2 Stocks You'll Wish You Bought on the Dip (And 1 You'll Regret Owning)
